annotations.text:
Everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] still needs a real value: brand name, the prices, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, support hours, trial length, refund terms, the portal domain and the reseller branding terms.

The same strings live in lib/offer.ts in the repo, so page and canvas can be filled in together.

Motion: one staggered entrance per page (badge, headline, copy, buttons), then only ambient movement — the dots travel around the globe, the delivery markers pulse, the device strip runs. Buttons and cards lift on hover.
The globe here is drawn as SVG so it animates on the canvas. On the live site it is the cobe canvas from components/ui/globe.tsx — it spins, and you can drag it.
